purpose: Review a finite catalog of six residual minute-data mechanisms against the frozen 155-definition library, 142 numerical comparators, original source contracts and every terminal operator family before reading any protected value.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_realized_kernel_microstructure_noise_ratio_238m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: Compare a fixed-bandwidth realized-kernel estimate with ordinary within-half realized variance to score apparent one-minute microstructure-noise share.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.parameters: proposed kernel, bandwidth and variance-ratio normalization
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Diffusive variation, five-minute variance ratio, absolute-return serial persistence, price-update share and realized volatility already consume the same high-frequency noise-versus-signal state. Kernel and bandwidth selection add estimator multiplicity rather than a contract-distinct observation.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_ohlc_volatility_estimator_disagreement_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: Contrast proposed Parkinson, Garman-Klass and Rogers-Satchell intrabar volatility estimates over the fixed 240-bar session.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.parameters: proposed estimator set and disagreement normalization
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Intrabar body/range efficiency, close-location pressure, gap/body confirmation, range entropy, overlap and volatility families already expose the OHLC components. Contrasting named estimators is a deterministic recombination of those terminal operators.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_transaction_price_modality_dip_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: Apply a weighted modality statistic to active-bar log transaction prices amount/volume over the full session.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.parameters: proposed weighted dip or excess-mass estimator and null normalization
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Transaction-price consensus, Bowley skewness, dispersion resolution and VWAP pressure already terminate the level-distribution family and explicitly forbid alternate centers, quantiles and dispersion summaries. Modality testing changes the estimator, not the information state.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_return_path_persistent_homology_lifetime_238p
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: Embed the within-half cumulative return path and summarize persistent topological lifetimes across a proposed filtration.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.parameters: proposed embedding dimension, delay, filtration metric and lifetime aggregation
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Signed path efficiency, chord adherence, time-reversal asymmetry, path-area, recurrence and spectral families already consume ordered return geometry. Embedding, delay and filtration choices create a thresholded topology search over the same path.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_return_profile_functional_pca_residual_energy_238m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: Fit functional principal components to frozen development return profiles and score each stock-day by residual profile energy.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.parameters: proposed training fold, component count, centering and residual norm
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Morning-afternoon profile persistence, market idiosyncrasy, market synchronization, spectral entropy and complete-library model routes already expose profile shape and residualization. Selecting component count and fit sample reopens a fitted-model family without a new source state.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_high_amount_conditional_return_expected_shortfall_238m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: Estimate signed expected shortfall of within-half returns conditional on endpoint amount lying above a proposed empirical tail boundary.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.parameters: proposed amount-tail boundary, return-tail probability and signed normalization
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Amount-conditioned directional persistence, directional price-impact asymmetry, up-move amount share and return-amount tail-copula review already consume conditional direction and tail response. Choosing two empirical tail cutoffs after those results is threshold rescue.

selection.reason: All six proposals replace an estimator, introduce a tuning family or fit a model on terminal return-noise, OHLC, transaction-price, path-geometry, profile-dependence or amount-conditioned states.

decision.next_campaign_requirement: Continue only from a genuinely new finite prevalue mechanism or a separately accepted historically versioned point-in-time source whose original collection contract permits the proposed use.
